name: claudetto
description: Adds a lean output style, six role agents, and a status line command. Adds hooks that check edits and `git` calls, bound the context of subagents, and check Markdown line breaks.

decide.title: Second Opinion
decide.description: Use `off` for no second opinion, `claude` for a small Claude model, or `jev` for Jev (it needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, and the question goes to the TypeSafe API). Claude can use the second opinion only when this is not `off`.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Use `handoff` to write a handoff file in place of the compaction summary, or `built-in` for the compaction of Claude Code.
